answer_1.quote: We explore four code-switching task categories: sentiment analysis (SA), machine translation (MT), summarization (SUM), and word-level language identification (LID).
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include translated sentences, summaries, sentiment labels, and language tags for code-switched text.

answer_2.quote: We use the code-switched datasets from MixMT 2022 shared task ... In our experiment, We focus on Hinglish to English, as evaluating code-switched summary systematically with existing auto metrics has shown to be challenging for multilingual LLMs.
